authenticity_review: Perceptual quality is high: sharp focus, natural lighting, no noise/compression artifacts (perceptual_quality_auditor severity=0.0). However, structural integrity has minor flaws: (1) whiskers appear as floating lines not physically emerging from fabric pores, and (2) front paws of central rabbits show slight melting into the wooden table surface without clear shadow separation or toe definition. These are localized AI generation artifacts but do not dominate the overall image quality. Authenticity score adjusted to 4.3 to reflect that these are minor (severity ~1-2) issues in an otherwise clean render.
